spans.s:
1. सेध, अस्, m. going, reaching [cf. उत्-स्˚]; a tail
(according to some; cf. गो-ष्˚); (आ), f. a porcupine.

2. सेध, अस्, m. restraint, restraining, hindering;
[cf. नि-षेध under नि-षिध्.]
1. सेधन, अम्, n. the act of going.

2. सेधन, अम्, n. the act of restraining or keep-
ing off.

2. सेधित्वा, ind. (according to some) = सिद्ध्वा,
col. 2; [cf. 1. सेधित्वा under rt. 1. सिध्. ]
सेधक, अस्, आ, अम्, driving off, preventing.
सेधनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, = सेद्धव्य, col. 1.
